claims.text: Under Unity's 2026 pricing, Unity Personal is free while the company's total annual revenue plus funding stays under $200,000, which is not a per-game threshold, and Unity Pro costs $2,310 per seat per year when prepaid.
claims.label: agreed but unchecked

history.text: Under Unity's 2026 pricing, Unity Personal is free up to $200,000 in revenue and funding, and Unity Pro costs $2,310 per seat per year when prepaid.
history.reason: The new run's checked Unity page shows the threshold counts total company revenue plus funding rather than per-game revenue.

claims.label: verified

claims.text: Unity IAP provides a unified first-party purchasing API that covers both the Apple App Store and Google Play.
claims.label: verified

claims.text: Godot's April 2026 mobile update lists plugin coverage, performance, testing and mobile workflows as areas that still need work.
claims.label: verified

claims.text: For mobile games, Unity tends to suit heavier 3D on mid-range phones, while Godot suits 2D and lighter 3D.
claims.label: agreed but unchecked

claims.label: agreed but unchecked

claims.label: verified

claims.text: For a two-person mobile team with equal experience in Unity and Godot, Unity likely has the lower risk-adjusted three-year total cost, but this is an engineering judgment about integration labour rather than a measured result.

disputes.text: Whether Unity has first-party or official integrations with major ad networks, such as LevelPlay mediation, while Godot mostly relies on community plugins, is unconfirmed because the checker could not verify it.
disputes.resolution: The Unity side is settled: LevelPlay officially mediates major ad networks such as AdMob and AppLovin, which is verified. The Godot side is still disputed and is carried forward as a new open dispute.

disputes.text: Whether Godot's baseline Android export size is roughly 15–20 MB is unsettled, and no current build-size benchmark was found.
Whether Godot has no official ad mediation and relies only on community plugins or custom native bridges remains disputed.
